translations.title: Musa Ecommerce
translations.description: Plataforma de comercio electrónico B2C orientada a la venta y distribución de productos agrícolas perecederos. Construida en Next.js con renderizado híbrido (SSR/ISR), sincronización de existencias en tiempo real, geolocalización de entregas y checkout optimizado.

facts.label: Escala y catálogo
facts.value: Catálogo de perecederos y abarrotes con actualización en tiempo real

facts.label: Impacto operativo
facts.value: 99.9% precisión de inventario · -35% latencia de respuesta

caseStudy.context: Musa Markets (https://musa.markets/) es un marketplace y supermercado digital orientado a productos frescos, perecederos y alimentos de alta demanda. La plataforma requería una experiencia de compra ágil, amigable y con visualización transparente de precios, ofertas del día y estado de inventario para compradores residenciales y minoristas.
caseStudy.roleIntro: Lideré el diseño y construcción de la tienda digital en Next.js, TypeScript y Tailwind CSS, integrando microservicios internos GraphQL para sincronizar precios y disponibilidad en milisegundos.

tldr.title: Qué es
tldr.body: Plataforma digital e-commerce para compras de supermercado y perecederos con navegación por departamentos y checkout en línea.

tldr.title: Mi rol
tldr.body: Desarrollo frontend integral: catálogo, carrito reactivo, pasarelas de pago y diseño responsive optimizado para móviles.

tldr.title: Impacto
tldr.body: 99.9% de precisión en stock sincronizado y -35% de latencia frente a sistemas web tradicionales.

responsibilities.title: Catálogo interactivo y navegación por categorías
responsibilities.body: Construí componentes de cuadrícula de productos con renderizado optimizado, badges de descuento y filtros rápidos.

responsibilities.title: Carrito de compras reactivo y persistencia local
responsibilities.body: Gestión de estado de canasta con actualización instantánea de subtotales, cálculo de cargos de envío y soporte offline.

responsibilities.title: Optimización de Core Web Vitals
responsibilities.body: Compresión adaptativa de imágenes WebP, precarga inteligente de rutas y Server Components para lograr navegación instantánea.

sections.title: Reto y restricciones
sections.lead: El negocio requería un canal digital de alta disponibilidad capaz de gestionar inventario de alta rotación (perecederos), reglas por categoría y procesos de pago rápidos sin sobrecargar la infraestructura.

items.title: Visualización fidedigna de inventario perecedero con rotación diaria
Desempeño óptimo en dispositivos móviles con redes celulares 3G/4G
Integración desacoplada con el backend administrativo y GraphQL

sections.title: Enfoque
sections.lead: Diseñé la arquitectura frontend con Next.js, TypeScript y Tailwind CSS, integrando microservicios internos GraphQL/Nest.js. Implementé optimizaciones de renderizado y validaciones estrictas en el cliente.

translations.title: Musa Ecommerce
translations.description: B2C e-commerce storefront for selling and distributing fresh agricultural and perishable products. Built in Next.js with hybrid rendering (SSR/ISR), real-time stock synchronization, delivery zone routing, and frictionless mobile-first checkout.

facts.label: Scale & Catalog
facts.value: Perishables and groceries catalog with real-time stock updates

caseStudy.context: Musa Markets (https://musa.markets/) is an online marketplace dedicated to fresh produce, perishable groceries, and everyday household essentials. The platform demanded a responsive, intuitive shopping journey with transparent pricing, daily discounts, and real-time inventory visibility.
caseStudy.roleIntro: Led frontend architecture and implementation using Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, integrating internal GraphQL microservices for millisecond-fast price and stock updates.

tldr.title: What it is
tldr.body: Digital marketplace and e-commerce web platform for fresh grocery orders with aisle navigation and online checkout.

tldr.title: My Role
tldr.body: Complete frontend engineering: dynamic catalog, reactive cart state, checkout flows, and mobile responsiveness.

tldr.title: Impact
tldr.body: 99.9% inventory sync accuracy and a 35% reduction in API response latency compared to traditional systems.

responsibilities.title: Interactive catalog and aisle browsing
responsibilities.body: Engineered high-performance product grids with optimized image delivery, discount badges, and instant search.

responsibilities.title: Reactive cart and local persistence
responsibilities.body: Client-side cart state management with real-time subtotal computation, delivery fee handling, and offline resilience.

responsibilities.title: Core Web Vitals optimization
responsibilities.body: Adaptive WebP image compression, route prefetching, and Server Components for instant navigational feedback.

sections.title: Challenge & constraints
sections.lead: The business required a high-availability digital channel to handle fast-rotating perishable inventory, category-based rules, and frictionless checkout flows under high traffic.

items.title: Reliable real-time stock sync for perishable items with daily inventory turnover
Smooth performance on mid-tier mobile smartphones over 3G/4G cellular connections
Decoupled microservice architecture integrating GraphQL and admin management

sections.title: Approach
sections.lead: Architected the frontend using Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, integrating internal GraphQL/Nest.js microservices. Implemented client-side performance optimizations and strict data validation.

sections.title: Musa Digital Shopping Experience
sections.lead: Modules engineered to maximize conversion and streamline online grocery orders.

items.title: Musa Marketplace & Web Storefront
items.summary: Dynamic groceries catalog and promotional highlights
items.body: Web storefront optimized for rapid discovery, seasonal hero banners, and high-conversion daily deals.

items.title: Aisle Browsing & Fresh Produce
items.summary: Clear price breakdown and departmental navigation
items.body: Structured catalog layout organized across fresh produce, pantry goods, and household staples with live pricing.

items.title: Partner Stores & Multi-Vendor Hub
items.summary: Dedicated storefronts for local merchants and bodegas
items.body: Independent branch profiles and curated inventories allowing customers to order directly from their preferred local vendors.

items.title: Mobile Shopping & Reactive Cart
items.summary: Frictionless ordering over 3G/4G cellular connections
items.body: Touch-first shopping experience with 1-click cart addition and instant delivery fee computation.

sections.title: Order Cycle & Delivery in Musa Markets
sections.lead: End-to-end customer journey from product discovery to doorstep delivery.

items.title: 1. Marketplace discovery & storefront
items.summary: Intuitive browsing of merchants and daily featured specials
items.body: Customers browse the responsive storefront, explore seasonal promotions, and choose local vendors.

items.title: 2. Aisle navigation & fresh perishables
items.summary: Faceted aisle search with live pricing per kg or unit
items.body: Product search across grocery categories with real-time inventory updates and clear savings badges.

items.title: 3. Local partner store fulfillment
items.summary: Order routing to nearest neighborhood branch
items.body: Multi-vendor fulfillment engine maps items to the closest merchant hub to accelerate dispatch times.

items.title: 4. Reactive mobile cart & delivery dispatch
items.summary: Real-time inventory verification and automated checkout
items.body: Shoppers finalize orders seamlessly on mobile with 99.9% inventory sync accuracy and automated delivery tracking.

sections.title: Results
sections.lead: Successful launch of the online channel with 99.9% inventory sync accuracy and a 35% reduction in response latencies compared to the legacy system.
